name: Quarterly Review Paper
tagline: Warm newsprint paper with a bold masthead, brick-red italics, hairline rules and justified serif columns (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: cream newsprint with ink-black type and a single brick-red accent

typography.style: didone-style display serif, readable text serif, tiny tracked sans mastheads

best_for: Text-rich talks that read like a magazine feature: reviews, essays, policy and strategy notes. Handles multi-column body copy and a small chart well.
avoid_for: Fast, high-energy pitches with big imagery.
